scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide city street with tall buildings on both sides, lined with trees and cars parked along the curb. The street has a few pedestrians and vehicles moving along it. There are several large buildings on either side of the street, including a brown building with many windows and balconies on the right, and a tan building with a flat roof on the left. A white truck is driving down the street, and there are several other vehicles parked along the curb. The sky is bright and sunny.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings have different styles and heights. The brown building has a modern look with many windows and balconies, while the tan building has a more traditional look with a flat roof. Both buildings appear to be residential, with many windows and balconies.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with asphalt and has a smooth surface. There are also concrete sidewalks and curbs along the street.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are several trees lining the street, some with pink flowers blooming on them.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs along the street, including a large sign on the front of the brown building.
scene_analysis.ground_surfaces: The ground is made of asphalt and has a smooth surface.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: There are several people walking along the sidewalk, but they are not crowded.
scene_analysis.lighting_atmosphere: The lighting is bright and sunny, with a few clouds in the sky.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The street is a quiet neighborhood with a mix of residential and commercial properties.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: The street is a convenient location for commuters.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The street is a popular spot for tourists to visit.
